messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

To him, you gave Isaac, and to Isaac you gave Jacob and Esau.","verse":15},{"chapter":3,"text":"You set apart Jacob for yourself, but rejected Esau. Jacob became a great multitude.","verse":16},{"chapter":3,"text":"It came to pass that when you led his descendants out of Egypt, you brought them up to Mount Sinai.","verse":17},{"chapter":3,"text":"You bowed the heavens also, shook the earth, moved the whole world, made the depths tremble, and troubled the age.","verse":18},{"chapter":3,"text":"Your glory went through four gates, of fire, of earthquake, of wind, and of ice, that you might give the law to the descendants of Jacob, and the commandment to the descendants of Israel.","verse":19},{"chapter":3,"text":"â€œYet you didnâ€™t take away from them their wicked heart, that your law might produce fruit in them.","verse":20}],"book_code":"2ES"}
